d: Noble Panacea is a new revolutionary skincare brand, founded by Nobel Laureate Sir Fraser Stoddart, launched in October 2019. The ground-breaking OSMV™ Technology at the core of the brand enables transformational efficacy and precision. We create with intention and deep respect by adhering to the global principles of green chemistry. We take our commitment to nature and sustainability to all stages of product development, from R&D; to packaging. Ultimately, we strive to promote absolute skin health by empowering all who seek authentic, natural, and ageless beauty.

We are looking for a highly motivated, experienced, and service-oriented Beauty Advisor & Aesthetician. As a Noble Panacea Beauty Advisor & Aesthetician, you will represent the brand and offer in-depth knowledge of our products and technology. You will be responsible for sales performance, daily operations of the counter with emphasis on performing facials, personalized customer service, clienteling, and follow-up. You will provide welcoming, authentic, and personalized service to achieve all customer service and sales targets. With your passion for people; the environment and company; products and services, you will ensure that each customer has a unique and memorable in-store experience which educates, inspires, and delights them.

You will also use your exceptional people skills to build collaborative working relationships with the rest of your team to ensure that the counter along with the treatment room meet Noble Panacea’s high standards of visual merchandising. If you are passionate about beauty and luxury and an ambitious self-starter looking for a progressive career within the Retail Beauty Industry, then this could be the perfect role for you and a great opportunity to be part of a dynamic and passionate team.
q: 5 years of experience working as a Beauty Advisor
Experience preferably with luxury/niche skincare brands
r: Present Noble Panacea to clients, educate and share product knowledge about OSMV™ technology, ingredients, features & benefits and demonstrate when necessary, according to the unique brand protocol.
Expertly perform Noble Panacea facial protocols daily and during events to deliver a luxurious experience and foster client loyalty.
Be aware of new skincare trends and integrate them into customer conversations.
Provide passion for beauty and excellent customer service at all times.
Show proactive behavior, especially during quiet periods, to maximize productivity.
Be sales target-oriented with proven experience in achieving year-on-year growth.
Demonstrate self-confidence and professionalism in all client interactions.
Display a resolutive and ambitious approach, working as part of a team to achieve both personal and team goals.
Build loyalty by recruiting new clients and maintaining them in the CRM system.
Develop strong social skills and maintain positive relationships with clients and Harrods staff.
Communicate clearly and frequently with Sales and Education Manager to ensure effective brand support.
Ensure floor presentation meets Noble Panacea’s brand guidelines.
Maintain detailed business and treatment records for forecasting and planning.
Act as Noble Panacea brand ambassador in-store to promote awareness and inter-sell.
Be self-driven, adaptable, and resilient in a fast-paced, competitive retail environment.

d: Risk Director / Chief Risk Officer (Regulated Financial Services) – Bahrain

DCS Card Centre is a financial institution founded in 1973 and formerly known as Diners Club Singapore. We bring decades of expertise and commitment to payments, and innovative digital solutions to DeCard.

With a strong heritage rooted in the space, our expertise in delivering secure, reliable, and cutting-edge payment solutions is licensed by the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) and governed under the Banking Act.
Functionally to the Board of Directors and Board Risk Committee
CBB-approved Senior Management / Controlled Function covering
The CRO will lead the Company's independent Risk Management function across its regulated PSP and crypto-asset businesses in Bahrain.

The role is responsible for establishing and maintaining the enterprise risk management framework, risk appetite, policies, controls, monitoring, reporting, and governance processes. The CRO will advise and challenge senior management on all material risks while ensuring compliance with Central Bank of Bahrain (CBB) requirements.

Previous experience leading a risk management function.
Direct exposure to PSP, electronic payments, card payments, acquiring, issuing, or crypto businesses is highly preferred.

Operational, Liquidity, Market, Counterparty and Cyber Risk
Strong Board and regulator-facing communication skills
Knowledge of Bahrain regulatory environment and CBB requirements
Strong stakeholder management skills with the confidence to influence executive decision-making

Capable of engaging effectively with Boards

r: Develop and maintain the enterprise-wide risk management framework.
Identify, assess, monitor, mitigate, and report material risks.
